payload.title: A new account's CDK bootstrap and hosted zones have no repeatable setup
payload.description: Left open by PPY-9d1b3e. infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh makes the pipeline roles and GitHub connection repeatable, and infra/pipeline/README.md lists the order for a new account, but nothing creates the CDK bootstrap (its assets bucket) or the public hosted zones the stacks look up, today anth.us, and SES sandbox exit is a request to AWS. The first-create path of papyrus-monitoring on an empty account is tested against a fake only and has never been rehearsed on a real empty account. Ryan's rule: nothing about setting up an account may be local knowledge.
